label: Figure 7.1: The market for tea
alt: Downward-sloping demand curve D and upward-sloping supply curve S crossing at the equilibrium price Pe and quantity Qe for tea.
caption: The demand curve D and supply curve S for tea intersect once, at equilibrium price P<sub>e</sub> and quantity Q<sub>e</sub>. At P<sub>e</sub> quantity demanded equals quantity supplied, so the market clears and stays there until an outside disturbance occurs.
